comparisons.statement: Lucas completed the comparable 1,000 m low-rate Concept2 record 4 seconds faster than the pre-regatta synthetic reference at the same 12 SPM.
limitations: This is a within-workout observed difference; the evidence does not establish why the time changed.

comparisons.statement: Bianca completed the comparable 2,000 m Concept2 record 12 seconds slower than the pre-regatta synthetic reference at the same 26 SPM average.
limitations: Fatigue, intent, resistance setting, recovery, and other human context remain unknown.

comparisons.statement: Marina's comparable 1,000 m activation was within 1 second of the pre-regatta synthetic reference.
limitations: The observation is narrow to this workout shape and does not establish a broader trend.

comparisons.statement: Atlas Men 4x recorded a different on-water pace pattern during a 7.8 m/s tail-cross wind session.
limitations: Wind, current, lineup, equipment, course, and session intent prevent attribution to the crew.

comparisons.statement: Andre has one expected post-regatta training day without an individual or linked crew record.
limitations: Rest, absence, unlinked evidence, and another modality remain possible explanations.

comparisons.statement: Sofia's post-regatta interval has no equivalent pre-regatta workout shape in the package.
limitations: The record can be preserved, but a direction-of-change comparison is unsupported.
